title: Summary labels: one value, a type alone, or Mixed rules
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, tier A 35% markup in every range.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix B, tier A Markup % with different values per range.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix C, tier A Markup % in one range and Margin % in another.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click tier A's row on the Tiers list.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Tier A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's Work Order Matrix value reads 35% markup.
  • Matrix B's reads % markup.
  • Matrix C's reads Mixed rules.
